name: Matrix.orthogonalGroup
type: (n : Type u) → [DecidableEq n] → [Fintype n] → (R : Type v) → [CommRing R] → Submonoid (Matrix n n R)
provides: The group of square matrices whose transpose is their inverse, packaged as a submonoid with a group instance on its subtype.
